item.title: Isuzu D-MAX, mu-X post standout performance in 2025 DOE Fuel Eco-Run
item.description: Isuzu proves its fuel-sipping diesel edge as the D-MAX and mu-X post impressive results in the 2025 DOE Fuel Eco-Run.

item.title: Kia’s keeping the manual and wagons alive with the K4 Sportswagon
item.description: Kia reveals the K4 Sportswagon, a stylish estate offering turbo engines, modern tech, and of course, a large cargo bay.

item.title: 2026 BYD Seal Advanced Review
item.description: The BYD Seal Advanced challenges crossover dominance with sleek design, EV performance, and a tempting price tag.

item.title: Hongqi’s AWD Flagship EVs shine in real-world efficiency test at DOE Eco Run
item.description: The EHS7, EH7, and EHS9 represented Hongqi at the 2025 DOE Eco Run, returning impressive real-world efficiency results.

item.title: Hyundai reveals the 2026 Staria Electric
item.description: Revealed at the 2026 Brussels Motor Show, Hyundai’s Staria MPV gets an electric powertrain and an updated exterior.

item.title: More for less? What the Chery Tiggo Touring brings to the table
item.description: Looking for a crossover that punches above its weight? Look no further than the feature-packed Chery Tiggo Touring.

item.title: No physical license? LTO says LTMS e-driver’s license is valid for traffic stops
item.description: The Land Transportation Office reminds drivers that the e-license via LTMS is a valid substitute for inspections.

item.title: JETOUR’s T2 SUV nets five-star ASEAN NCAP safety rating
item.description: JETOUR’s rugged T2 shines in ASEAN NCAP tests, achieving a five-star safety rating with an impressive 86.5-point score.

item.title: Women’s Worldwide Car of the Year awards the Hyundai IONIQ 9 as World’s Best Large SUV
item.description: The Hyundai IONIQ 9 wins World’s Best Large SUV at the 2026 WWCOTY Awards and advances to the Supreme Winner finals.

item.title: Changan kicks off 2026 with the launch of the refreshed CS15
item.description: Updated inside and out, the refreshed CS15 offers added tech and comfort while staying at an accessible price point.
